title: Morning Brief: A big day for inflation
title_zh: 早间简报：通胀的重要一天
summary: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge showed pricing pressures remained elevated for the month of February, even before the US and Israel began their military campaign against Iran and triggered an oil shock.
summary_zh: 美联储首选的通胀指标显示，即使在美国和以色列开始针对伊朗的军事行动并引发石油冲击之前，二月份的价格压力仍然很高。

title: Chips are still where the AI trade's rubber meets the road
title_zh: 芯片仍然是人工智能行业的关键
summary: Semiconductors get a massive upgrade, but contemplating the risks to chipmakers suggests how the AI hype train might stall or even disintegrate.
summary_zh: 半导体得到了大规模升级，但考虑到芯片制造商面临的风险，人工智能炒作列车可能会停滞甚至瓦解。

title: Arm in Pole Position for AI: Liontrust's Pleydell-Bouverie
title_zh: 人工智能领域的领先者：Liontrust 的 Pleydell-Bouverie
summary: Arm's move to sell its own chips has been largely cheered by investors. One of those investors supportive of the plan is Clare Pleydell-Bouverie, Fund Manager at Liontrust. Liontrust's top tech investments include Nvidia, Broadcom and TSMC.
summary_zh: Arm出售自有芯片的举动在很大程度上受到了投资者的欢呼。 Liontrust 基金经理 Clare Pleydell-Bouverie 是支持该计划的投资者之一。 Liontrust 的顶级科技投资包括 Nvidia、Broadcom 和 TSMC。

title: Apple leads global smartphone shipments in first quarter, Counterpoint says
title_zh: Counterpoint 称苹果第一季度智能手机出货量领先
summary: iPhone-maker Apple ‌led ‌smartphone shipments in ​the first quarter, growing 5% ‌year-on-year, ⁠even as overall ⁠global shipments ​remained ​under pressure ​due ‌to a shortage of memory components and ‌weak ​consumer ​sentiment, ​Counterpoint ‌Research said on ​Friday.
summary_zh: Counterpoint Research 周五表示，尽管由于内存组件短缺和消费者信心疲弱，全球整体出货量仍然面临压力，但 iPhone 制造商苹果第一季度智能手机出货量仍处于领先地位，同比增长 5%。

title: TSMC revenue surges 35% on AI chip demand
title_zh: AI芯片需求带动台积电营收大增35%
summary: STORY: :: TSMCThe world's largest contract chipmaker, TSMC, saw first-quarter revenue surge 35% thanks to the AI boom. Revenue from January-March hit $35.7 billion, beating market forecasts on surging interest in artificial intelligence applications.Friday's results are i...
summary_zh: 故事：::台积电全球最大的代工芯片制造商台积电，得益于人工智能的蓬勃发展，第一季度收入飙升 35%。1 月至 3 月的收入达到 357 亿美元，超出了市场对人工智能应用兴趣高涨的预期。周五的结果是...

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks edge higher as investors eye US-Iran peace talks
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：投资者关注美伊和谈，股市小幅走高
summary: FTSE 100 was steady on Friday morning amid uncertainty over the US-Iran ceasefire deal, ahead of upcoming peace talks
summary_zh: 在即将举行的和平谈判之前，由于美伊停火协议存在不确定性，富时 100 指数周五上午保持稳定

title: Apple to shutter its first unionized US store in Maryland
title_zh: 苹果将​​关闭位于马里兰州的第一家美国工会商店
summary: April 9 (Reuters) - Apple said on Thursday that it will shut down its retail store in Towson, Maryland, the first of its U.S. locations where retail employees successfully unionized in 2022.
summary_zh: 4 月 9 日（路透社）——苹果周四表示，将关闭位于马里兰州陶森的零售店，这是 2022 年零售员工成功加入工会的美国第一家零售店。

title_zh: Meta 撤下旨在招募社交媒体成瘾诉讼原告的广告
summary: By Diana Novak Jones CHICAGO, April 9 (Reuters) - Meta Platforms said on Thursday it is pulling ads from Facebook and Instagram aimed at recruiting new plaintiffs for ongoing litigation accusing it
summary_zh: 芝加哥，4 月 9 日（路透社） - Meta Platforms 周四表示，它正在从 Facebook 和 Instagram 上撤下广告，旨在招募新的原告，以应对正在进行的指控它的诉讼

title: Is Anthropic's Claude Mythos an AI nightmare waiting to happen?
title_zh: Anthropic 的克劳德神话是一场即将发生的人工智能噩梦吗？
summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) is claiming that its new Claude Mythos AI model may be too powerful and is limiting its release after it reportedly “found thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities, including some in every major operating system and web browser," and could be used to hac...
